Este notebook estima en **Larch** las especificaciones comparables del notebook
[`03_models/16_eod2012_income_proxy_stepwise.qmd`](/Users/vicenteonetto/Desktop/FCFM/MDS/Tesis_Local/tesis-project/03_models/16_eod2012_income_proxy_stepwise.qmd).

Objetivo:

- contrastar `MNL` y `Nested` fuera de Biogeme;
- comparar atributos de viaje agregados/alternativo-específicos versus atributos observados por viaje;
- mantener la misma muestra objetivo, variables territoriales parsimoniosas y lectura de `BIP` como referencia para variables comunes.

::: {.callout-note}
En **Larch**, el parámetro del nido se expresa como `Mu:QR` con rango `(0, 1]`.
Para compararlo con Biogeme:

`MU_biogeme ~= 1 / Mu:QR_larch`
:::

## 1) Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
print("label: setup")

import gc
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("MPLCONFIGDIR", "/tmp/mplconfig")
os.environ.setdefault("XDG_CACHE_HOME", "/tmp/xdg-cache")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
from scipy.stats import norm

if os.environ.get("LARCH_DISABLE_NUMBA_CACHE", "1") == "1":
    import numba as nb

    _original_njit = nb.njit
    _original_guvectorize = nb.guvectorize

    def _njit_without_cache(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs["cache"] = False
        return _original_njit(*args, **kwargs)

    def _guvectorize_without_cache(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs["cache"] = False
        return _original_guvectorize(*args, **kwargs)

    nb.njit = _njit_without_cache
    nb.guvectorize = _guvectorize_without_cache

import larch as lx
if not all(hasattr(lx, attr) for attr in ["P", "X", "Model", "Dataset"]):
    raise ImportError(
        "Este kernel no tiene una instalación completa de Larch. "
        f"Se importó {lx!r}, pero no expone P, X, Model ni Dataset."
    )

from larch import P, X


def resolve_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / "config").exists() and (candidate / "lib").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("No se pudo resolver PROJECT_ROOT desde el notebook actual.")


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
```

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")


def parse_sample_fraction_from_tag(sample_tag: str) -> float | None:
    if sample_tag == "full":
        return None
    if not (sample_tag.startswith("sample") and sample_tag.endswith("pct")):
        return None
    return int(sample_tag.removeprefix("sample").removesuffix("pct")) / 100


def ensure_unique_keys(df: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str], context: str) -> None:
    duplicated = df.group_by(keys).len().filter(pl.col("len") > 1)
    if duplicated.height:
        raise ValueError(f"{context} tiene llaves duplicadas para {keys}")


def assert_left_join_preserves_rows(before_rows: int, after_rows: int, context: str) -> None:
    if before_rows != after_rows:
        raise ValueError(f"{context} cambió filas: antes={before_rows:,}, después={after_rows:,}")


def standardize_over_used_zones(
    df_zone_model_ready: pl.DataFrame,
    df_est_base: pl.DataFrame,
    raw_vars: list[str],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df_used_zones = (
        df_est_base
        .select(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("ZONA777"))
        .drop_nulls()
        .unique()
    )
    df_used = df_zone_model_ready.join(df_used_zones, on="ZONA777", how="inner")
    df_out = df_zone_model_ready
    for raw_var in raw_vars:
        mu = df_used.select(pl.col(raw_var).mean()).item()
        sd = df_used.select(pl.col(raw_var).std()).item()
        if mu is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No se pudo calcular media para {raw_var} sobre zonas usadas")
        if sd is None or sd == 0:
            sd = 1.0
        df_out = df_out.with_columns(
            ((pl.col(raw_var) - pl.lit(float(mu))) / pl.lit(float(sd))).alias(f"{raw_var}_z")
        )
    return df_out


def read_zone_model_ready_sources(paths: list[Path]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    missing_paths = [p for p in paths if not p.exists()]
    if missing_paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existen zone model-ready full requeridos: {missing_paths}")

    df_zone = None
    for path in paths:
        df_next = pl.read_parquet(path)
        ensure_unique_keys(df_next, ["ZONA777"], path.name)
        if df_zone is None:
            df_zone = df_next
            continue

        duplicate_cols = sorted((set(df_zone.columns) & set(df_next.columns)) - {"ZONA777"})
        if duplicate_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"Columnas duplicadas al combinar fuentes zone model-ready: {duplicate_cols}")
        df_zone = df_zone.join(df_next, on="ZONA777", how="inner")

    return df_zone


def augment_censo_zone_sources(df_zone: pl.DataFrame, raw_vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    missing = set(raw_vars) - set(df_zone.columns)
    derived_exprs = []
    if "share_mujeres" in missing:
        derived_exprs.append(
            (pl.col("n_mujeres") / pl.when(pl.col("n_per") != 0).then(pl.col("n_per"))).alias("share_mujeres")
        )
    if "share_asistencia_parv" in missing:
        derived_exprs.append(
            (
                pl.col("n_asistencia_parv")
                / pl.when(pl.col("n_edad_0_5") != 0).then(pl.col("n_edad_0_5"))
            ).alias("share_asistencia_parv")
        )
    if not derived_exprs:
        return df_zone
    if not CENSO_AGG_FINAL_PATH.exists():
        return df_zone

    dependencies_by_var = {
        "share_mujeres": {"n_mujeres", "n_per"},
        "share_asistencia_parv": {"n_asistencia_parv", "n_edad_0_5"},
    }
    required = {"ZONA777"} | {
        dep
        for raw_var in missing
        for dep in dependencies_by_var.get(raw_var, set())
    }
    df_agg = pl.read_parquet(CENSO_AGG_FINAL_PATH)
    if not required.issubset(df_agg.columns):
        return df_zone

    df_derived = df_agg.select(["ZONA777", *sorted(required - {"ZONA777"})]).with_columns(derived_exprs)
    derived_cols = [c for c in ["share_mujeres", "share_asistencia_parv"] if c in missing and c in df_derived.columns]
    if not derived_cols:
        return df_zone
    return df_zone.join(df_derived.select(["ZONA777", *derived_cols]), on="ZONA777", how="left")


def fill_missing_raw_with_median(df_zone: pl.DataFrame, raw_vars: list[str], context_name: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    exprs = []
    for col in raw_vars:
        if col not in df_zone.columns:
            continue
        median_value = df_zone.select(pl.col(col).median()).item()
        if median_value is None:
            continue
        missing_count = df_zone.select(pl.col(col).is_null().sum()).item()
        if missing_count:
            print(
                f"ℹ️ Imputando {missing_count} zonas sin {col} "
                f"con mediana {context_name}/ZONA777 ({median_value:.6f})."
            )
        exprs.append(pl.col(col).fill_null(median_value).alias(col))
    if not exprs:
        return df_zone
    return df_zone.with_columns(exprs)


def complete_used_zones_with_medians(
    df_zone: pl.DataFrame,
    df_est_base: pl.DataFrame,
    raw_vars: list[str],
    context_name: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df_zone_min = df_zone.select(["ZONA777", *raw_vars])
    df_used_zones = (
        df_est_base
        .select(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("ZONA777"))
        .drop_nulls()
        .unique()
    )
    df_missing_zones = df_used_zones.join(df_zone_min.select("ZONA777"), on="ZONA777", how="anti")
    if df_missing_zones.is_empty():
        return df_zone_min

    median_exprs = []
    for col in raw_vars:
        median_value = df_zone_min.select(pl.col(col).median()).item()
        if median_value is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No se pudo imputar {col} en {context_name}: mediana nula")
        median_exprs.append(pl.lit(float(median_value)).alias(col))
    print(
        f"ℹ️ Imputando {df_missing_zones.height} zonas usadas sin fila {context_name} "
        "con medianas zonales antes de estandarizar."
    )
    df_imputed = df_missing_zones.with_columns(median_exprs)
    return pl.concat([df_zone_min, df_imputed], how="vertical")


def zone_std_is_ready(path: Path, required_cols: set[str], context_name: str) -> bool:
    if not path.exists():
        return False
    existing_cols = set(pl.scan_parquet(path).collect_schema().names())
    missing_cols = sorted(required_cols - existing_cols)
    if missing_cols:
        print(f"ℹ️ Re-materializando {context_name} model-ready std: faltan {missing_cols}")
        return False
    if not BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        return True

    df_used_zones = (
        pl.read_parquet(BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH)
        .select(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("ZONA777"))
        .drop_nulls()
        .unique()
    )
    df_zone_keys = pl.read_parquet(path, columns=["ZONA777"]).unique()
    missing_zone_count = df_used_zones.join(df_zone_keys, on="ZONA777", how="anti").height
    if missing_zone_count:
        print(
            f"ℹ️ Re-materializando {context_name} model-ready std: "
            f"faltan {missing_zone_count} zonas usadas."
        )
        return False
    value_cols = sorted(required_cols - {"ZONA777"})
    df_zone_values = pl.read_parquet(path, columns=["ZONA777", *value_cols])
    null_cells = (
        df_used_zones
        .join(df_zone_values, on="ZONA777", how="left")
        .select(pl.sum_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_null().sum() for c in value_cols]).alias("n"))
        .item()
    )
    if null_cells:
        print(
            f"ℹ️ Re-materializando {context_name} model-ready std: "
            f"hay {null_cells} valores nulos en zonas usadas."
        )
        return False
    return True


def ensure_censo_model_ready_std() -> Path:
    required_cols = {"ZONA777", *CENSO_RAW_COLS, *CENSO_COLS}
    if zone_std_is_ready(CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, required_cols, "Censo"):
        return CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH
    if CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.exists():
        CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.unlink()

    if not BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe baseline sample para estandarizar Censo: {BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH}")
    df_base = pl.read_parquet(BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH)
    df_censo_full = read_zone_model_ready_sources([CENSO_BASE_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH, CENSO_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH])
    df_censo_full = augment_censo_zone_sources(df_censo_full, CENSO_RAW_COLS)
    missing_raw = sorted(set(CENSO_RAW_COLS) - set(df_censo_full.columns))
    if missing_raw:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Faltan variables raw Censo: {missing_raw}. "
            "Si falta share_asistencia_parv, regenera primero "
            "02_eda/tmp/censo2024_zona777/censo2024_zona777_agg_final.parquet."
        )
    df_censo_full = fill_missing_raw_with_median(df_censo_full, CENSO_RAW_COLS, "Censo")
    df_censo_full = complete_used_zones_with_medians(df_censo_full, df_base, CENSO_RAW_COLS, "Censo")
    df_censo_std = standardize_over_used_zones(df_censo_full, df_base, CENSO_RAW_COLS)
    df_censo_std.write_parquet(CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH)
    print(f"✅ Censo model-ready std escrito en: {CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH}")
    return CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH


def ensure_osm_model_ready_std() -> Path:
    required_cols = {"ZONA777", *OSM_RAW_COLS, *OSM_COLS}
    if zone_std_is_ready(OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, required_cols, "OSM"):
        return OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH
    if OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.exists():
        OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.unlink()

    if not BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe baseline sample para estandarizar OSM: {BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH}")
    if not OSM_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe OSM model-ready full: {OSM_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH}")

    df_base = pl.read_parquet(BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH)
    df_osm_full = pl.read_parquet(OSM_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH)
    missing_raw = sorted(set(OSM_RAW_COLS) - set(df_osm_full.columns))
    if missing_raw:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan variables raw OSM: {missing_raw}")
    df_osm_full = fill_missing_raw_with_median(df_osm_full, OSM_RAW_COLS, "OSM")
    df_osm_full = complete_used_zones_with_medians(df_osm_full, df_base, OSM_RAW_COLS, "OSM")
    df_osm_std = standardize_over_used_zones(df_osm_full, df_base, OSM_RAW_COLS)
    df_osm_std.write_parquet(OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH)
    print(f"✅ OSM model-ready std escrito en: {OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH}")
    return OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH


def ensure_eod_model_ready_std() -> Path:
    required_cols = {"ZONA777", *EOD_RAW_COLS, *EOD_COLS}
    if zone_std_is_ready(EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, required_cols, "EOD"):
        return EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH
    if EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.exists():
        EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH.unlink()

    if not BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe baseline sample para estandarizar EOD: {BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH}")
    if not EOD_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe EOD model-ready full: {EOD_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH}")

    df_base = pl.read_parquet(BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH)
    df_eod_full = pl.read_parquet(EOD_MODEL_READY_FULL_PATH)
    missing_raw = sorted(set(EOD_RAW_COLS) - set(df_eod_full.columns))
    if missing_raw:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan variables raw EOD: {missing_raw}")
    df_eod_full = fill_missing_raw_with_median(df_eod_full, EOD_RAW_COLS, "EOD")
    df_eod_full = complete_used_zones_with_medians(df_eod_full, df_base, EOD_RAW_COLS, "EOD")
    df_eod_std = standardize_over_used_zones(df_eod_full, df_base, EOD_RAW_COLS)
    df_eod_std.write_parquet(EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH)
    print(f"✅ EOD model-ready std escrito en: {EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH}")
    return EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH


def build_macrozone_lookup() -> pl.DataFrame:
    if not ZONAS777_SHP.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe shapefile ZONA777 para macrozonas: {ZONAS777_SHP}")
    import geopandas as gpd

    gdf = gpd.read_file(ZONAS777_SHP)[["ZONA777", "NMACROZONA", "MACROZONA", "COMUNA"]].copy()
    gdf["ZONA777"] = pd.to_numeric(gdf["ZONA777"], errors="coerce")
    gdf = gdf[gdf["ZONA777"].notna()].copy()
    gdf["ZONA777"] = gdf["ZONA777"].astype(int)
    gdf["NMACROZONA"] = pd.to_numeric(gdf["NMACROZONA"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    attrs = gdf.drop_duplicates(["ZONA777", "NMACROZONA", "MACROZONA", "COMUNA"]).copy()
    inconsistent = attrs.groupby("ZONA777").size()
    inconsistent = inconsistent[inconsistent.gt(1)]
    if not inconsistent.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"Hay ZONA777 con macrozona inconsistente: {sorted(map(int, inconsistent.index))}")
    attrs = attrs.drop_duplicates("ZONA777").copy()
    attrs["macrozone_model"] = attrs["MACROZONA"].astype(str)
    attrs.loc[attrs["NMACROZONA"].eq(7), "macrozone_model"] = "EXTERNA_ESPECIAL"
    observed = set(attrs["macrozone_model"].dropna().unique())
    expected = set(MACROZONA_DUMMY_LEVELS + [MACROZONA_BASE])
    unexpected = sorted(observed - expected)
    if unexpected:
        raise ValueError(f"Macrozonas no esperadas en ZONA777: {unexpected}")
    for level in MACROZONA_DUMMY_LEVELS:
        attrs[f"macro_{level.lower()}"] = attrs["macrozone_model"].eq(level).astype(float)
    return pl.from_pandas(attrs[["ZONA777", *MACROZONA_COLS]])


def add_macrozone_controls(df_trips: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df_macro = build_macrozone_lookup()
    ensure_unique_keys(df_macro, ["ZONA777"], "macrozone_lookup")
    before_rows = df_trips.height
    df = (
        df_trips
        .with_columns(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("ZONA777"))
        .join(df_macro, on="ZONA777", how="left")
        .drop("ZONA777")
    )
    assert_left_join_preserves_rows(before_rows, df.height, "join macrozona")
    missing_ratio = df.select(pl.any_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_null() for c in MACROZONA_COLS]).mean()).item()
    if missing_ratio != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Join macrozona dejó filas faltantes: {missing_ratio:.6%}")
    return df


def add_origin_controls_from_zone(
    df_trips: pl.DataFrame,
    zone_path: Path,
    cols: list[str],
    context_name: str,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if not cols:
        return df_trips
    if not zone_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe {context_name} model-ready std: {zone_path}")
    df_zone = pl.read_parquet(zone_path).select(["ZONA777", *cols])
    ensure_unique_keys(df_zone, ["ZONA777"], context_name)
    before_rows = df_trips.height
    df = (
        df_trips
        .with_columns(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("ZONA777"))
        .join(df_zone, on="ZONA777", how="left")
        .drop("ZONA777")
    )
    assert_left_join_preserves_rows(before_rows, df.height, f"join {context_name}")
    missing_ratio = df.select(pl.any_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_null() for c in cols]).mean()).item()
    if missing_ratio != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Join {context_name} dejó filas faltantes: {missing_ratio:.6%}")
    return df


def build_joint_eod_sample_if_needed(target_path: Path, baseline_path: Path) -> Path:
    required_cols = set(EXTRA_COLS)
    if target_path.exists():
        existing_cols = set(pl.scan_parquet(target_path).collect_schema().names())
        if required_cols.issubset(existing_cols):
            print(f"ℹ️ Reusando muestra Censo + OSM + EOD existente: {target_path}")
            return target_path
        target_path.unlink()

    ensure_censo_model_ready_std()
    ensure_osm_model_ready_std()
    ensure_eod_model_ready_std()
    if not baseline_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe baseline para muestra Censo + OSM + EOD: {baseline_path}")
    print(f"ℹ️ Construyendo muestra Censo + OSM + EOD: {target_path.name}")
    df = pl.read_parquet(baseline_path)
    existing = set(df.columns)
    if not set(CENSO_COLS).issubset(existing):
        df = add_origin_controls_from_zone(df, CENSO_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, CENSO_COLS, "Censo")
    if not set(OSM_COLS).issubset(set(df.columns)):
        df = add_origin_controls_from_zone(df, OSM_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, OSM_COLS, "OSM")
    if not set(EOD_COLS).issubset(set(df.columns)):
        df = add_origin_controls_from_zone(df, EOD_MODEL_READY_STD_PATH, EOD_COLS, "EOD")
    if not set(MACROZONA_COLS).issubset(set(df.columns)):
        df = add_macrozone_controls(df)
    df.write_parquet(target_path)
    print(f"✅ Muestra Censo + OSM + EOD escrita en: {target_path}")
    return target_path


def stratified_sample_partition_choice(df: pl.DataFrame, *, fraction: float | None, seed: int = 42) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if fraction is None:
        return df
    if not (0 < fraction <= 1):
        raise ValueError(f"fraction debe estar en (0,1], recibido: {fraction}")
    return (
        df.group_by("partition", "choice_nested", maintain_order=True)
        .map_groups(lambda g: g.sample(fraction=fraction, shuffle=True, seed=seed))
        .sort(["partition", "choice_nested"])
    )


def year_from_partition(partition: str) -> int:
    return int(partition.split("-W")[0])


def build_observed_trip_attrs_partition(partition: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    parquet_path = RAW_PARQUET_BY_PARTITION[partition]
    if not parquet_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe parquet raw para atributos observados {partition}: {parquet_path}")
    od_config = OdContextConfig(
        include_time_dummies=False,
        time_dummy_variant="v2",
        mean_mode="leave_one_out",
        require_all_alternatives=True,
    )
    lf = read_parquet_portable(str(parquet_path))
    df_caract = load_caracterizacion(resolve_caracterizacion_path(None, partition))
    df_od_alt = build_od_alt_specific_context_table(lf, df_caracterizacion=df_caract, config=od_config)
    df = build_trip_dataset_with_alt_specific_context(
        lf,
        df_caracterizacion=df_caract,
        df_od_alt_context=df_od_alt,
        time_dummy_variant=od_config.time_dummy_variant,
        mean_mode=od_config.mean_mode,
        drop_chosen_singletons=True,
        include_realized_metrics=True,
    )
    return df.with_columns(
        [
            pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
            pl.lit(year_from_partition(partition)).alias("year"),
            (pl.lit(year_from_partition(partition)) == 2025).cast(pl.Int8).alias("DUMMY_ANIO_2025"),
            pl.when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PM") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PM"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PT") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PT"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_VALLE") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_VALLE"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("NO_LAB"))
            .alias("franja_v2"),
        ]
    )


def build_observed_trip_attrs_sample_if_needed() -> Path:
    required_cols = set(COMMON_BASE_COLS + AGGREGATED_TRIP_ATTR_COLS + OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTR_PASSTHROUGH_COLUMNS)
    if OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        existing_cols = set(pl.scan_parquet(OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH).collect_schema().names())
        if required_cols.issubset(existing_cols):
            print(f"ℹ️ Reusando muestra observed-trip-attrs existente: {OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH}")
            return OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH
        OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH.unlink()

    if not BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe baseline sample requerido: {BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH}")
    if not FULL_TRIPS_CONTEXT_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe trips context full requerido: {FULL_TRIPS_CONTEXT_PATH}")

    print("ℹ️ Construyendo muestra observed-trip-attrs...")
    df_base_sample = pl.read_parquet(BASELINE_SAMPLE_PATH)
    lf_full_context = read_parquet_portable(str(FULL_TRIPS_CONTEXT_PATH))
    full_context_n = lf_full_context.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
    effective_fraction = df_base_sample.height / full_context_n
    fraction = parse_sample_fraction_from_tag(ESTIMATION_SAMPLE_TAG)
    replication_fraction = round(effective_fraction, 3)
    if fraction is not None and abs(effective_fraction - fraction) > 1e-6:
        print(
            "ℹ️ La fracción efectiva difiere del tag: "
            f"tag={fraction:.6%}, efectiva={effective_fraction:.6%}. "
            f"Se usa {replication_fraction:.3%}."
        )

    valid_origins = (
        lf_full_context.select(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False))
        .drop_nulls()
        .unique()
        .collect()
        .get_column("zona_inicio_viaje")
        .to_list()
    )
    frames = []
    for partition in RAW_PARQUET_BY_PARTITION:
        frames.append(build_observed_trip_attrs_partition(partition))
        gc.collect()
    df_observed_full = (
        pl.concat(frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
        .with_columns(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False))
        .filter(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").is_in(valid_origins))
    )
    if df_observed_full.height != full_context_n:
        raise ValueError(
            "La reconstrucción observed no replica trips_context full: "
            f"full_context={full_context_n:,}, observed_full={df_observed_full.height:,}"
        )

    context_keys = ["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"]
    context_cols = [
        "N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA_RAW",
        "N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA",
        "LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA",
        "N_BUS_STOPS",
        "BUS_STOP_DENSITY",
        "LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY",
        "N_METRO_STATIONS",
        "METRO_STATION_DENSITY",
        "LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY",
        "BUS_LINE_COUNT",
        "LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT",
        "METRO_LINE_COUNT",
        "LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT",
    ]
    df_context_controls = lf_full_context.select(context_keys + context_cols).unique().collect()
    ensure_unique_keys(df_context_controls, context_keys, "df_context_controls_observed")
    before_rows = df_observed_full.height
    df_observed_full = df_observed_full.join(df_context_controls, on=context_keys, how="left")
    assert_left_join_preserves_rows(before_rows, df_observed_full.height, "join controles contexto observed")
    missing_context = df_observed_full.select(
        pl.any_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_null() for c in context_cols]).mean()
    ).item()
    if missing_context != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Join controles contexto observed dejó faltantes: {missing_context:.6%}")

    df_observed_sample = stratified_sample_partition_choice(
        df_observed_full,
        fraction=replication_fraction,
        seed=42,
    )
    row_diff = abs(df_base_sample.height - df_observed_sample.height)
    row_diff_ratio = row_diff / df_base_sample.height
    if row_diff_ratio > 0.0001:
        raise ValueError(
            "La muestra observed no replica tamaño histórico: "
            f"baseline={df_base_sample.height:,}, observed={df_observed_sample.height:,}"
        )
    if row_diff:
        print(f"⚠️ Diferencia menor a 0,01% entre baseline y observed: {row_diff} filas.")
    df_observed_sample.write_parquet(OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH)
    print(f"✅ Muestra observed-trip-attrs escrita en: {OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH}")
    return OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTRS_SAMPLE_PATH


def ensure_active_sample_artifacts(specs: list[dict]) -> None:
    if any(spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "aggregated_alt_specific" for spec in specs):
        build_joint_eod_sample_if_needed(AGGREGATED_SAMPLE_PATH, JOINT_CENSO_OSM_SAMPLE_PATH)
    if any(spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "observed_common" for spec in specs):
        observed_base = build_observed_trip_attrs_sample_if_needed()
        build_joint_eod_sample_if_needed(OBSERVED_SAMPLE_PATH, observed_base)


def assert_active_sample_paths_exist(specs: list[dict]) -> None:
    missing_paths = sorted({spec["sample_path"] for spec in specs if not spec["sample_path"].exists()})
    if not missing_paths:
        return
    message = "\n".join(f"- {path}" for path in missing_paths)
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "Faltan artefactos requeridos para correr las especificaciones activas en Larch.\n"
        f"{message}\n\n"
        "Para sample5pct, primero materializa desde el notebook 16 los artefactos "
        "`censo4-micro-osm-eod2012` y `censo4-micro-osm-eod2012-observed-trip-attrs`."
    )


def required_columns_for_spec(spec: dict) -> list[str]:
    if spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "aggregated_alt_specific":
        trip_cols = AGGREGATED_TRIP_ATTR_COLS
    elif spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "observed_common":
        trip_cols = OBSERVED_TRIP_ATTR_COLS
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"trip_attr_mode desconocido: {spec['trip_attr_mode']}")
    return COMMON_BASE_COLS + trip_cols + EXTRA_COLS


def load_larch_numeric_df(path: Path, cols: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema_names = pl.scan_parquet(path).collect_schema().names()
    missing = sorted(set(cols) - set(schema_names))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas requeridas en {path.name}: {missing}")
    df = (
        pl.scan_parquet(path)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col(c).cast(pl.Int32).alias(c)
                if c == "choice_nested"
                else pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64).alias(c)
                for c in cols
            ]
        )
        .collect()
    )
    null_counts = df.null_count().row(0)
    bad_nulls = {c: n for c, n in zip(df.columns, null_counts) if n}
    if bad_nulls:
        raise ValueError(f"Columnas con nulls en {path.name}: {bad_nulls}")
    return df.to_pandas()


def prepare_larch_dataframe(pandas_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pdf = pandas_df.copy()
    remap = {0: 1, 1: 2, 2: 3}
    pdf["choice_larch"] = pdf["choice_nested"].replace(remap).astype("int32")
    pdf = pdf.drop(columns=["choice_nested"])
    for col in pdf.columns:
        if col == "choice_larch":
            continue
        pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("float64")
    return pdf


def build_larch_stats_frame(model: lx.Model, n_obs: int, spec: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    stats_raw = model.estimation_statistics_raw(compute_loglike_null=True)
    stats = {
        "model": spec["label"],
        "family": spec["family"],
        "trip_attr_mode": spec["trip_attr_mode"],
        "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
        "Number of estimated parameters": len(model.pf),
        "Number of free parameters": int((model.pf["holdfast"] == 0).sum()),
        "Sample size": int(n_obs),
    }
    for key, value in stats_raw.items():
        label = " | ".join(str(k) for k in key) if isinstance(key, tuple) else str(key)
        stats[label] = value
    return pd.DataFrame([stats])


def build_larch_params_frame(model: lx.Model, spec: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pf = model.pf.copy().reset_index().rename(columns={"param_name": "Param", "value": "Value"})
    robust_std_err = np.asarray(model.parameters["robust_std_err"].values, dtype=float)
    robust_t = np.where(
        np.isfinite(robust_std_err) & (robust_std_err > 0),
        pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float) / robust_std_err,
        np.nan,
    )
    robust_p = np.where(np.isfinite(robust_t), 2 * norm.sf(np.abs(robust_t)), np.nan)
    lower = pf["minimum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    upper = pf["maximum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    value = pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    active_lower = np.isfinite(lower) & (np.abs(value - lower) <= 1e-6)
    active_upper = np.isfinite(upper) & (np.abs(value - upper) <= 1e-6)
    pf["model"] = spec["label"]
    pf["family"] = spec["family"]
    pf["trip_attr_mode"] = spec["trip_attr_mode"]
    pf["Robust std err."] = robust_std_err
    pf["Robust t-stat."] = robust_t
    pf["Robust p-value"] = robust_p
    pf["Active bound"] = active_lower | active_upper
    pf["Biogeme-comparable MU"] = np.where(
        pf["Param"] == "Mu:QR",
        np.where(value != 0, 1.0 / value, np.nan),
        np.nan,
    )
    return pf[
        [
            "model",
            "family",
            "trip_attr_mode",
            "Param",
            "Value",
            "Robust std err.",
            "Robust t-stat.",
            "Robust p-value",
            "minimum",
            "maximum",
            "Active bound",
            "Biogeme-comparable MU",
        ]
    ].rename(columns={"minimum": "Lower bound", "maximum": "Upper bound"})


def result_paths(spec: dict) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    model_dir = RESULTS_DIR / spec["label"]
    model_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return (
        model_dir / f"stats_{spec['label']}.csv",
        model_dir / f"params_{spec['label']}.csv",
    )
```

```{python}
#| label: model-builders
print("label: model-builders")


def add_common_qr_terms(v, alt: str):
    return (
        v
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LAB_PM") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LAB_PT") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_NO_LAB") * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_ANIO_2025") * X.DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LOG_DEMAND") * X.LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY") * X.LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT") * X.LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT") * X.LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
    )


def add_extra_terms(v, alt: str):
    for col in EXTRA_COLS:
        tag = PARAM_TAGS[col]
        v = v + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_{tag}") * getattr(X, col)
    return v


def add_aggregated_trip_terms(v, alt: str):
    suffix = {"BIP": "BIP", "QR_RED": "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER": "QR_OTHER"}[alt]
    return (
        v
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_VEH") * getattr(X, f"TVH_{suffix}")
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_ESPERA_INI") * getattr(X, f"TEI_{suffix}")
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_ESPERA_TRASB") * getattr(X, f"TET_{suffix}")
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_N_TRASB") * getattr(X, f"NTR_{suffix}")
    )


def add_observed_trip_terms(v, alt: str):
    return (
        v
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_VEH") * X.OBS_TVH
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_ESPERA_INI") * X.OBS_TEI
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_T_ESPERA_TRASB") * X.OBS_TET
        + getattr(P, f"B_{alt}_N_TRASB") * X.OBS_NTR
    )


def build_larch_model(pandas_df: pd.DataFrame, spec: dict) -> lx.Model:
    pdf = prepare_larch_dataframe(pandas_df)
    alts = {1: "BIP", 2: "QR_RED", 3: "QR_OTHER"}
    ds = lx.Dataset.construct.from_idco(pdf, alts=alts)
    model = lx.Model(ds)
    model.title = spec["label"]
    model.compute_engine = "numba"
    model.choice_co_code = "choice_larch"
    model.availability_co_vars = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1}

    if spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "aggregated_alt_specific":
        model.utility_co[1] = add_aggregated_trip_terms(0, "BIP")
        v_qr_red = add_aggregated_trip_terms(P.ASC_QR_RED, "QR_RED")
        v_qr_other = add_aggregated_trip_terms(P.ASC_QR_OTHER, "QR_OTHER")
    elif spec["trip_attr_mode"] == "observed_common":
        model.utility_co[1] = 0
        v_qr_red = add_observed_trip_terms(P.ASC_QR_RED, "QR_RED")
        v_qr_other = add_observed_trip_terms(P.ASC_QR_OTHER, "QR_OTHER")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"trip_attr_mode desconocido: {spec['trip_attr_mode']}")

    v_qr_red = add_extra_terms(add_common_qr_terms(v_qr_red, "QR_RED"), "QR_RED")
    v_qr_other = add_extra_terms(add_common_qr_terms(v_qr_other, "QR_OTHER"), "QR_OTHER")
    model.utility_co[2] = v_qr_red
    model.utility_co[3] = v_qr_other

    if spec["family"] == "nested":
        model.graph.new_node(parameter="Mu:QR", children=[2, 3], name="QR")
    else:
        model.initialize_graph(alternative_codes=[1, 2, 3], alternative_names=["BIP", "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER"])

    model.ordering = [
        ("ASCs", "ASC_.*"),
        ("Time Dummies", "B_QR_.*_(LAB_PM|LAB_PT|NO_LAB)"),
        ("Interannual", "B_QR_.*_ANIO_2025"),
        ("Demand", "B_QR_.*_LOG_DEMAND"),
        ("Offer", "B_QR_.*_LOG_(BUS_STOP_DENSITY|BUS_LINE_COUNT|METRO_LINE_COUNT)"),
        ("LOS", "B_.*_(T_VEH|T_ESPERA_INI|T_ESPERA_TRASB|N_TRASB)"),
        ("Censo", "B_QR_.*_(SHARE_.*)"),
        ("OSM", "B_QR_.*_(OSM_.*)"),
        ("EOD", "B_QR_.*_(EOD2012_.*)"),
        ("Macrozonas", "B_QR_.*_(MACRO_.*)"),
        ("LogSums", "Mu:.*"),
    ]
    model.set_cap(LARCH_MAX_CAP)
    if spec["family"] == "nested" and "Mu:QR" in model.pf.index:
        mu_idx = model.pf.index.get_loc("Mu:QR")
        model.pf.iloc[mu_idx, model.pf.columns.get_loc("minimum")] = 0.01
        model.pf.iloc[mu_idx, model.pf.columns.get_loc("maximum")] = 1.0
        model.pf.iloc[mu_idx, model.pf.columns.get_loc("value")] = 0.8
    return model


def estimate_larch_spec(spec: dict) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cols = required_columns_for_spec(spec)
    pandas_df = load_larch_numeric_df(spec["sample_path"], cols)
    model = build_larch_model(pandas_df, spec)
    model.maximize_loglike(method=LARCH_METHOD, quiet=False, options=LARCH_OPTIONS)
    model.calculate_parameter_covariance(robust=True)
    stats = build_larch_stats_frame(model, n_obs=len(pandas_df), spec=spec)
    params = build_larch_params_frame(model, spec=spec)
    del pandas_df, model
    gc.collect()
    return stats, params
```

```{python}
#| label: run-larch-specs

params_frames = []

        print(f"Estimando Larch: {spec['label']}")
        stats_path, params_path = result_paths(spec)
        stats_df, params_df = estimate_larch_spec(spec)
        stats_df.to_csv(stats_path, index=False)
        params_df.to_csv(params_path, index=False)
        stats_frames.append(stats_df)
        params_frames.append(params_df)
else:
```


## 11) Tabla wide de parámetros

```{python}
#| label: larch-parameters-wide
print("label: larch-parameters-wide")


def parse_param_name(param: str) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    if param == "Mu:QR":
        return None, "MU_QR"
    if param == "ASC_QR_RED":
        return "QR_RED", "ASC"
    if param == "ASC_QR_OTHER":
        return "QR_OTHER", "ASC"
    for alt in ["BIP", "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER"]:
        prefix = f"B_{alt}_"
        if param.startswith(prefix):
            return alt, param.removeprefix(prefix)
    return None, param


if df_params_all.empty:
    print("No hay parámetros cargados.")
else:
    df_wide_src = df_params_all.copy()
    parsed = df_wide_src["Param"].map(parse_param_name)
    df_wide_src["alternative"] = [x[0] for x in parsed]
    df_wide_src["variable"] = [x[1] for x in parsed]
    df_wide_src = df_wide_src[df_wide_src["alternative"].notna()].copy()
    df_wide = df_wide_src.pivot_table(
        index=["model", "family", "trip_attr_mode", "variable"],
        columns="alternative",
        values=["Value", "Robust t-stat.", "Robust p-value"],
        aggfunc="first",
    )
    df_wide.columns = [f"{metric}_{alt.lower()}" for metric, alt in df_wide.columns.to_flat_index()]
    df_wide = df_wide.reset_index().sort_values(["model", "variable"], kind="stable")
    with pd.option_context("display.max_columns", None, "display.max_rows", None):
        display(df_wide)
```

## 12) Lectura esperada

- `mnl_aggregated_alt_specific`: auditoría Larch del candidato parsimonioso anterior con atributos agregados por alternativa.
- `nested_aggregated_alt_specific`: sensibilidad nested sobre esa misma definición.
- `mnl_observed_common`: auditoría Larch de la sensibilidad con atributos observados por viaje.
- `nested_observed_common`: sensibilidad nested de la especificación observada.
- En Larch, si `Mu:QR` queda cerca de `1`, el nido QR colapsa hacia MNL; si queda interior pero no significativo o con error estándar grande, tampoco justificaría preferir `Nested`.
